## Routing checkpoints

- The failed ref is reported as unfetched with its reason.

**All fetches fail, with accompanying free text:** repair is aborted. Create mode is offered from the accompanying text, and no ticket content is guessed.

## Create checkpoint

1. Use one temp root.
2. The parent does the clarification and the bounded overlap discovery before any scout runs.
3. Store the clarified ask in `<tmp>/create/snapshot.md`. The discovered candidate's body goes in a separate untrusted block.
4. Run one audit over the ask.
5. Fold findings only into the create-anyway body and into added or changed enrichment prose. Unrelated legacy ACs keep their original bytes.
6. Keep the existing overlap alternative menu: enrichment, create-anyway and no-write. Add the Drop row only if a confirmed obsolete verdict exists.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and repairs audit-lines: Before's ABC-103 gates (in (a) and (b)) inserted the Applicability note between the Audit line and Title, so Audit was not immediately above Title, whereas After moves that note below the roast dispositions and puts Audit directly above Title in both full gates. No fact regressed, but two spots are fragile: checkpoint (b) in After re-presents ABC-103 with only the changed receipt row and no Audit/Title header, which a stricter reader could count as a gate lacking the Audit-above-Title layout, and the ABC-103 body diff uses a `...` elision rather than the whole body. To stay safe while honoring the word cap, have the re-presentation repeat the one-line `Audit:` and `Title:` header above its row-level diff, and either show the full ABC-103 diff or state explicitly that the elided sections are byte-identical. Also restore `url` in step (d)'s re-fetch list to match the description/state/url mapping, and keep the `[recommended]` tag only on the single approve row as done now; the obsolete/close/drop menu additions belong only where a confirmed verdict exists, which After already states for the create menu.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: The only fact that moved is first-gate, and it moved in the intended direction: Before's preparation section narrates ABC-102's wishful-AC stop and ABC-103's uniqueness repair before the ABC-101 gate, while After keeps the preparation paragraph generic ("Preparation covers every ticket before this first gate") and discloses nothing about later tickets until continuation (a). Every other fact Before kept is still kept in After — the exact ABC-101 diff with the inventory sentence demoted to a verbatim Reporter note, Audit immediately above Title at each gate, the local ABC-102 stop with no approval option followed by the ABC-103 gate, the atomic count/order split with both displaced originals in the note, revision re-presentation, off-turn approval refusal, re-fetch/compare then body-then-comment write, one-line-per-ref statuses, routing outcomes, and the create checkpoint with parent discovery before a single scout. After also correctly adds the single [recommended] menu row and an explicit "No close option: the audit establishes no obsolete verdict" line, which is the right way to surface the new obsolete-judgment contract without inventing a close choice on a clean audit. To stay safe going forward, keep the rule that preparation text may describe the process for all tickets but may never name a later ticket's outcome, finding, or stop before its own gate; and consider stating "fetch serially, one snapshot/audit per distinct ref" in the entry block as well as the routing block, since the dedup fact is currently carried by the routing line plus the per-ref directory wording rather than an explicit entry statement.
